rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a personal journal or diary of daily experiences.

example.english: I write in my diary every day, recording what happened that day.
example.traditional: 我每日都寫日記，記低嗰日發生嘅事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 se2 jat6 gei3 gei3 dai1 go2 jat6 faat3 sang1 ge3 si6

rows.note: Use this for a personal planner or organizer used to track appointments, rather than a journal.

example.english: I use my diary to note next week's appointments.
example.traditional: 我用手帳記低下星期啲約會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 zoeng3 gei3 dai1 haa6 sing1 kei4 di1 joek3 wui2
